_comment: Edit this file to change what the launcher suggests. No rebuild, no release, nobody has to update anything: the launcher fetches it every time the MODS tab is opened. Keys are in English so anyone can edit it.
_about_featured: Mods shown at the top of the MODS tab. The label is free text and NOT a measured number: nothing here counts downloads, because the files are served by GitHub and nobody keeps a tally. Write what you mean — 'Recommended', 'Most used', 'Pick of the week' — rather than a figure that looks measured and isn't. `id` must match the mod's folder name.
